architecture: Two task heads (MLP16), with two frozen phone probes
training_description: Deletion head:238 training pairs. Frozen quality head:418 combined-kind training pairs. Development corpus:147 pairs; kind-specific calibration. Words हैन and किनकि excluded from fitting; their development regressions used for release rollback.
evaluation_description: Full-region waveform edits across two cohorts:64 same-voice change/sham pairs and44 word families, with two held-out conditioning groups. The quality row pools7 earlier and18 follow-up pairs. Clear source/donor phone evidence was required; this is not real Hindi-error accuracy.

voice_audit.limits: Nuisance sensitivity relative to the same recorded reference, not Native-error FPR or validated Hindi intonation. WORLD reconstruction can alter phonetic detail.

limitations: Only two user-confirmed real errors; other flags are candidate Hindi-compatible changes.
Observed zero sham flags in46 selected controls does not establish zero Native-error false positives.
Short nucleus edits often preserve much of the inter-consonant region and were detected less often; both audits are retained.
Reference style, G2P and shared acoustic-probe biases constrain inference; unsupported sites abstain.
Prosody is shown as relative pitch/duration evidence. Hindi-specific intonation accuracy is unvalidated.
Teacher-reference mode also flags14 human word occurrences; deployment must not equate all such disagreements with Hindi leakage.
Quality evaluation now has25 selected positive/sham pairs across21 word families; general quality-error performance and Hindi intonation remain unvalidated.
The128 new requested quality words yielded18 eligible physical pairs; requested spellings are not observed pronunciation labels.
Automatic cached/new references require content pass and per-site phonetic qualification. Two cached case texts have no content-pass teacher reference and explicitly abstain.
Optional query content checking rejects only gross mismatch. ASR quarantine is not an accent label and does not suppress valid known phonetic errors.

matched_region_audit.meaning: Matched source readings, different edit extent; CTC unit peaks omit blank-labeled frames between consonant peaks. This is an edit-detection diagnostic, not human phoneme-absence gold.

word_coverage.meaning: All86 scored same-text cases; supported modeled vowel contrast only, not all possible pronunciation errors.

deployment_reference_audit.interpretation: Same-text teacher reference sensitivity, not human-error labels. Human variants, TTS reference mistakes and phone/G2P errors remain possible.

quality_followup.bootstrap_recipe: 4000 resamples of word families,seed20261109; shared2 conditioning groups are not new independent speaker cohorts
limits: Only18 of256 new canonical readings met the full source/donor/segmentation eligibility rules;128 requested words are not128 observed-error examples.
Phone-probe qualification favors clear realizations and shares acoustic biases with the detector.
Known waveform replacements establish a local edit, not actual Hindi origin, naturalness or Hindi intonation.
The two audits use new words/carriers but share two previously heldout conditioning groups.
Zero observed sham flags does not establish zero Native-error false positives; real reference-mode variation flags remain separately reported.
ASR agreement checks intended lexical content, not word-level pronunciation or Hindi influence.
English loans, transcript spelling and code switching can cause ASR quarantine even for intelligible speech.
